easyPrerequisites:
Niv-Mizzet doesn't have summoning sickness.
Your library isn't empty.
description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet by tapping it, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Niv-Mizzet.
Repeat.
